traits.growth_form.note: USFS FEIS, Tamarix spp. species review (Zouhar 2003; read 2026-10-19): shrubs or shrub-like trees with numerous large basal branches.

traits.stem_clump.note: USFS FEIS, Tamarix spp. species review (Zouhar 2003; read 2026-10-19): numerous large basal branches; multi-stemmed.

traits.leaf_habit.note: USFS FEIS, Tamarix spp. species review (Zouhar 2003; read 2026-10-19): the foliage is deciduous (athel tamarisk, T. aphylla, is evergreen). FOC vol. 13: green vegetative branchlets fall in winter.

traits.short_shoots.note: Flora of China vol. 13, Tamarix (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): two kinds of branch: woody long growing branches that stay through winter, and green leafy vegetative branchlets that fall in winter (deciduous twigs, not spur-like short shoots).

traits.leaf_hairs.note: Flora of China vol. 13, Tamarix (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves glabrous, rarely hairy.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of China vol. 13, Tamarix (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): racemes lateral on the growing branches of the previous or current year, often clustered in terminal panicles; flowers usually pedicellate, bract 1.

traits.flowering_position.note: USFS FEIS, Tamarix spp. species review (Zouhar 2003; read 2026-10-19): spring racemes rise laterally from old wood, summer panicles end the young shoots of the season (FOC vol. 13 the same).

traits.bract_form.note: Flora of China vol. 13, Tamarix (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): bract 1 per flower, small.

traits.flower_merosity.note: Flora of China vol. 13, Tamarix (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): 4- or 5(or 6)-merous; FNA vol. 6 key: 5-merous in all but T. parviflora.

traits.stamens.note: Flora of China vol. 13, Tamarix (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stamens 4 or 5 opposite the calyx lobes, or numerous (T. tenuissima's reported 10).

traits.carpels.note: Flora of China vol. 13, Tamarix (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): pistil of 3 or 4 carpels; styles 3 or 4 (FNA: 3, or 4).

traits.capsule_valves.note: Flora of China vol. 13, Tamarix (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): capsule conic, opening in 3 from the back.

traits.fruit_shape.note: Flora of China vol. 13, Tamarix (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): capsule conic; ovoid is the nearest state (the vocabulary has no cone shape for a fruit).
